$comment: First Load JS budget of each route in kB (gzip, 1 kB = 1000 bytes), checked by scripts/bundle-budget.mjs. Raising a budget or adding a route needs a reason in that route's entry; lowering one needs none.

/.reason: The sidebar gains an Accounts entry (claude-account-rotation step 4), loaded on every page. The sidebar gains an Agents entry, and the chunks shared with the new Agents pages are regrouped (agent-profiles-group-chat step 4).

/accounts.reason: The Accounts page: the member's accounts with their state, usage, runs and cost, and the rotation policy of each project (claude-account-rotation step 4). It gains Add Claude account and Renew token, and a reminder for each token that ends within 30 days (claude-account-login step 2); the dialog itself loads on demand (next/dynamic), so the page carries only its buttons, the reminder and their icons. Each account's usage limits show as a bar per window under its row (account-usage-bars): the UsageLimits detail, its model, the kit's Meter and the browser clock (hooks/use-now) are the page's main content, so they load with it. The sidebar gains an Agents entry, and the chunks shared with the new Agents pages are regrouped (agent-profiles-group-chat step 4).
